notes:
Movies and episodes have a seek bar you can use. With a remote, press Up from the buttons to select it, then Left or Right to move; hold to go faster, and the video jumps there when you stop or press OK. On a phone or tablet, tap or drag it.

Favorites: a guide with just your favorite channels, plus any channel showing a show or movie you've favorited in the next 12 hours. On tablets, foldables and TV it's under Live TV once you've favorited something. On a phone, add it to your menu bar in Settings > Menu bar.

Settings > Providers shows your providers straight away, as tiles of the same size, with Add provider among them. Back from editing a provider returns to that page.

Settings > About starts with View onboarding (moved from General) and View changelog; the diagnostics tools are under them.

TV: Back hides the player's controls first; it leaves full screen only when nothing is showing. Settings > General: with Start playing when the app opens on, a new Open in full screen option starts your last channel full screen. About's two buttons are joined in one pill.

Fixed: a high-bitrate movie could make StreamMate close by itself on a TV. The player buffered so much video that the app ran out of memory; it now buffers less (still plenty to ride out a slow connection).
